topic: US Dairy Product Imports in Four Countries from 2018 to 2020
passage: The graph above shows US dairy product imports in selected countries from 2018 to 2020.
Among the four countries above, Mexico inconsistently recorded the highest imports of US dairy products from 2018 to 2020.
[연결사], US dairy product imports in Mexico increased from 2019 to 2020, while the reverse was true in the other three countries while the same period.
In Indonesia, US dairy product imports in 2020 were more than twice that in 2018.
The increase in US dairy product imports in the Philippines from 2018 to 2019 were smaller than those in Indonesia in the same period.
China was the only country which imports of US dairy products dropped between 2018 and 2019.
